column1: # subset.tsv -- the pinned kana->kanji dictionary source (M186c #3180).
# Provenance: every row is a (reading, surface) pair as it appears in
# the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group's Japanese
# dictionary. JMdict is distributed under the Creative Commons
# because the repo ban is GPL-family only; the licence is recorded in
# user/go/ime/THIRD-PARTY.txt and the text ships beside the packed
# Coverage note (what this subset is, and is not):
#   * ~120 of the most common JMdict entries — the card's "smallest
#     useful subset", not the full ~190k-entry JMdict.
#   * One row per (reading, surface). `rank` is the frequency proxy the
#     card requires: 1 is the most common surface for that reading
#     (JMdict's common-word / news>ichi>spec marking), higher is rarer.
#     kana + kyoiku kanji + symbols, ~1900 glyphs) cannot draw are
#     EXCLUDED so a committed candidate never paints .notdef: 寿司 猫
#     誰 彼 涼しい 狭い 遅い 嬉しい 鮨 箸 端 突き 蛙 and friends are
#     absent on purpose, not by accident.
#   * Out by design: kana-only entries, okurigana variants, multiword
#     segmentation, readings outside this file. A reading absent here
#     yields kana-only candidates — never a wrong kanji.
